card.name: Final piece of enzyme brand names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a brand name for an enzyme replacement drug, mainly the 'ME' ending NEXVIAZY-ME and CEREZY-ME. It also fires on the 'U' in TRUVU-type names.

modes.label: Brand name ending ME
modes.description: The closing 'ME' of an enzyme therapy brand name such as NEXVIAZYME or CEREZYME in warnings and dosing text.
modes.example: discontinue NEXVIAZY<<ME>> immediately and initiate appropriate medical treatment.

modes.label: Other name endings
modes.description: Rare cases where the closing piece of a split brand name or an unrelated word is marked.
modes.example: IFY TRUV<<U>> Organ/Tissue Mean Absorbed dose
